title: 1800 case: balls of light come out of the water

tellings.quote: This case dates back to 1800. Balls of light emerging from the water, hovering alongside the craft, following the craft, and then taking off into the clouds.

plain: In a case from the year 1800, balls of light are said to have risen out of the sea, hovered beside a ship, followed it, and then shot off into the clouds. The researcher Kevin Knuth describes it to Michels without naming where the account comes from. He tells it to show that sightings like this go back long before modern times.
